title: cli: install, update and report the published skills at the server's version, with or without a project
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

A person who only connected an MCP client has no way to install the skills. A person with a project has no command to refresh them after an upgrade, so the local knowledge quietly falls behind the server.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/cli`, `packages/skills`). Reader: every user of the skills.

## Evidence

- The only install path is `create-objectstack`, which runs a third-party sync at scaffold time. No `os` command refreshes `.claude/skills/`.
- `os validate --target` warns when the local skills version differs from the target's (`packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts:235`); nothing repairs it.
- Nothing documents an install for a user with no project (`content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`).
- Vendors solve version skew with a command: `npx convex ai-files install|update|status`, `stripe agent setup`, `nb init`, and the Next.js rules block refreshed on upgrade.

## Scope

- `os skills install`, `os skills update`, `os skills status`: copy the catalog at a named version, default the active target's version, into the agent's skills directory; report installed versus target.
- Works in an empty directory and in a project.
- The open server's instructions and `/mcp/skill` name this command (sibling card #34686).

## Done when

- In an empty directory, the command installs the catalog matching a running server's version, and `status` reports a mismatch after the server is upgraded.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Decision record: #34691 S3 = A; #34659 D4 = A. Related: #34686.
- Dedup, open and closed: none found for `os skills install`.
